_doc: KARL ERIK dating cabinet (#32, Wave D, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #38). Karl Erik Ottendahl (1942-2004), Aalborg — the affordable-Danish-handmade house. LEVERS: the 1987 US-export STOP (resumed 2000), the 1990 back-to-one-man-shop grading switch, the 'Ottendahl' signature label (Germany, late 90s+), the 2004 death ceiling, and the ⚠️ Planta/Design-Berlin TRAP (German-market 'Karl Erik' pipes from ~1998/99 are GERMAN-made, not Danish). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Karl_Erik.json (detailed). Single-source -> approx flags on soft edges.

history_anchors._doc: b.1942 Aalborg. Lithographer apprenticeship at 16; carved pipes as gifts. 1962-65: Nairobi (lithographer) — made his own pipes there. ~1965: back in Denmark, side-line pipes under his prenames 'KARL ERIK' (KE logo) -> Copenhagen stores -> full-time. MANUFACTURE ERA: first co-workers ~1967/68; the WALLY FRANK Ltd (NYC) contract = the US engine; up to 15 craftsmen (Bent Nielsen + Peder Christian Jeppesen later independent — artisan links); honest hybrid method: machine-roughed (NO copy-milling), hand-finished; most stems supplied near-finished by STANWELL, who also did most of KE's sandblasting (stanwell link). Label/second brands he produced: Champ of Denmark, Garrick, Knute (rusticated second), Sven Egholm (second), Wenhall (NYC), Larsen & Stigart (shop brand; also 'Shelburne'), JOBEY DANSK for Weber Pipe Co (Tinder Box catalogs 1970s-80s; Jobey moved to Butz-Choquin Saint-Claude in 1987 — see jobey.json). II S / II SM / I S / I M / I B stamped pipes = almost certainly US-ONLY sales (origin tales debunked in source). 1987: ALL US exports STOPPED (waning sales + price pressure). 1990: back to a ONE-MAN shop; NEW grading (D->A ascending + Ekstravagant C/B/A/AA/AAA) replaces the OLD numeric grading (4->1 ascending + 'Ekstravagant' one-offs). 1990s: designs models for Stanwell's H.C. Andersen line. ~1998/99: GERMAN rights to the 'Karl Erik' name traded to Planta Tabak (Design Berlin) -> German-market KE = db-made. 'OTTENDAHL' family-name signature = his OWN pipes for Germany-only distribution (some crossed to the US). 2000: US sales officially resumed (after 13 years). ~2000s: 2,000+ pipes/yr. Died Sept 12, 2004 (stroke, Korsør). Epilogue: Tom Eltang bought his lathe (-> Sara Eltang project).
history_anchors.conflict_notes: US-export stop '1987 ... after 13 years ... resumed 2000' is self-consistent. Kenya return: 'after three years' from 1962 -> ~1965 side-line start (approx).

brand_marks.physical: KE logo; 'KARL ERIK / HANDMADE IN DENMARK'. OLD grading: numbers 4-3-2-1 ascending + 'Ekstravagant' (fully handmade one-offs). NEW grading (1990+): letters D-C-B-A ascending; Ekstravagant graded C/B/A/AA/AAA. II-S-family stamps = US-market pipes (pre-1988). 'Ottendahl' signature = his German-market own pipes (late 90s-2004).
